dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Since Ritou has been selected as the site for the Irodori Festival, the Kanjou Commission must take responsibility for the proceedings.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Whether it be receiving the guests or setting the area up, nothing must be left to chance...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, and then there's the matter of our guests' safety! We must strengthen our seaside patrols...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry, I was so preoccupied with my work, I almost forgot to say hello.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler, it's you. Hello! Do you need anything from me today?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Mr. Kamaji...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: How can I be sure that my letter gets to you...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you to deliver the letter to Mr. Kamaji then. Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Oh, it's the Traveler. Hello! Do you need anything from me today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, I'm doing very well.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Thank you for delivering the letter for me earlier! You know, it's very difficult for Kamaji and I to write to each other due to our respective positions.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I believe that he must be very busy with the Kujou Clan's affairs. I don't want to bother him too often... Eh? He said that he wanted to visit me personally?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Ah... I don't think it would be possible based on the bad blood between our clans. Still... I'm very glad to know that he'd do that for me.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for you, we'd probably have been unable to reach out to each other for a long while. I'm most grateful to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Good luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Hiiragi Clan...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: My father's matters... I finally know the truth now.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: So that arrogant-sounding woman is...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: My elderly father is imprisoned. As his daughter, I am really worried about his condition.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: But... No matter who he is, as long as one makes a mistake, he must be held accountable for it.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: As for the outcome, we can only wait for the Almighty Shogun's judgment... Anyway, thank you for your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler, it's you. Hello! Do you need anything from me today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How've you been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Things at the estate are far more complicated than I could have anticipated. I haven't quite gotten the hang of it all just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Thankfully, everyone's been quite willing to listen to my suggestions, so I can start from the simplest matters and slowly sort everything out from there.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: The more I do this, the more I realize that these things are as urgent as they are laden with great meaning... and only I can do them.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I'm glad we didn't end up sinking even deeper into the mire back there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Keep it up!

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: It's thanks to you and the Yashiro Commissioner. I won't let your goodwill go to waste.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I've prepared a small gift for you. It's a small trinket that you can wear around. If you don't mind, please accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to the addendum to the announcement?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: The Matsuura Clan have already sent someone to handle that. Currently, everyone thinks that it was all a big misunderstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: There are still some ill-favored rumors going about, but I believe that they will disappear given time.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I will keep a close eye on that. Hopefully, nothing similar happens in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the wedding...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Kamaji and I talked it over afterward. He was very supportive of my current course of action.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: "I will wait for you, no matter how long it takes," he promised me. I must say that I was greatly relieved to hear that.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: The ceremonial matters may have been pushed back, yes, but I believe that our hearts grew closer together. That is of great comfort to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Good luck to you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's nothing worth mentioning.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: You don't have to be polite. Who knows... Maybe I'll need your help in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I've prepared a small gift for you. It's a trinket you can wear around. If you don't mind, please accept it.
